intro: Team Galactic will build a new world!

player_won: This is just a setback for Team Galactic...

player_lost: Nothing stops Team Galactic!

sinnoh_rowan_intro: Professor Rowan: You there! Are you familiar with Pokémon?
They are creatures of mystery, harboring unknown potential.
In my briefcase are three Pokémon. You may choose one.
Consider it a loan — until you prove yourself worthy.
Professor Rowan: Choose wisely. Turtwig, Chimchar, or Piplup.
sinnoh_rowan_starter: Professor Rowan: Your journey begins now. Do not disappoint me.
You received a Pokédex and 5 Poké Balls!
sinnoh_rowan_congrats: Professor Rowan: Incredible. You are the Sinnoh Champion.
You have fulfilled every expectation I placed in you.
The Pokémon world is vast. Your journey has only begun.
Take this — an updated Pokédex and access to the Battle Zone.
You received the NATIONAL DEX and BATTLE ZONE ACCESS!
sinnoh_looker_intro: Looker: I am Looker, of the International Police.
I am investigating a criminal organization known as Team Galactic.
Their leader, Cyrus, has plans that threaten all of Sinnoh.
Should you learn anything... find me.
sinnoh_looker_galactic_tip: Looker: Team Galactic is operating out of Veilstone City.
Their headquarters is behind the game corner.
Be careful. These people are not ordinary criminals.
sinnoh_cynthia_hm: Cynthia: You look like a capable trainer.
Team Galactic has been cutting down trees and blocking roads.
Take this — it lets your Pokémon learn Cut.
sinnoh_cynthia_celestic: Cynthia: The ruins here tell the story of Sinnoh's origin.
Dialga controls time. Palkia controls space.
And at the top of Mt. Coronet... the Spear Pillar.
That is where Team Galactic intends to awaken them.
sinnoh_celestic_elder: Elder: You carry the Old Charm from Cynthia's grandmother.
Long ago, two beings shaped the world at Spear Pillar.
The lake guardians — Uxie, Mesprit, and Azelf — keep them in balance.
If Team Galactic captures the lake trio, that balance shatters.
The elder taught you Surf. You can now use SURF outside of battle!
sinnoh_riley_intro: Riley: I sensed something unusual in this cave.
Team Galactic is using the Iron Island to harvest energy from Pokémon.
Join me. Together we can drive them out.
sinnoh_riley_egg: Riley: You fought bravely in there.
Here — take this egg. The Pokémon inside has chosen you.
sinnoh_galactic_jubilife: Galactic Grunt: Our commander Mars has a message for this city.
The old world must be erased for our new universe to be born!
If you get in our way, we'll erase you too!
sinnoh_cyrus_galactic_hq: Cyrus: You are persistent, I'll grant you that.
This world is incomplete. Emotion, willpower, knowledge — all imperfect.
I will use the power of Dialga and Palkia to destroy this world and rebuild it.
A new universe — one of my design, without spirit.
You cannot stop what has already begun.
sinnoh_cyrus_galactic_hq_won: You are an anomaly this world does not deserve.
Take this. The lake trio holds power you will need.
sinnoh_spear_pillar_event: The air trembles. Space and time warp around Spear Pillar!
Cyrus calls out to the heavens — Dialga and Palkia begin to awaken!
The lake guardians appear, straining to contain the chaos.
Cyrus: No! The spirit energy from the lake trio is disrupting everything!
The portal to another dimension tears open behind Cyrus...
sinnoh_mars_intro: Mars: You again? I'm Commander Mars of Team Galactic.
Cyrus-sama's vision will not be stopped by a child!
sinnoh_mars_won: Mars: How... how can you be so strong?
This isn't over. Cyrus-sama will see this through!
sinnoh_jupiter_intro: Jupiter: Commander Jupiter, at your service — to stop you.
Lake Acuity is ours. The Galactic Plan is unstoppable.
sinnoh_saturn_intro: Your interference at the lakes ends here.
sinnoh_cynthia_victory_road: Cynthia: I knew I'd see you here someday.
Just ahead is the Pokémon League. I'll be watching from inside.
Give the Elite Four everything you have.
sinnoh_barry_rival_intro: {rival_name}: Hey, {player_name}! I've been training so hard!
I'm gonna be the best trainer in Sinnoh — no, the WORLD!
But first I have to beat you. Fine! Let's go!
sinnoh_barry_rival_won: You're seriously the best. I'm gonna catch up, I promise!
sinnoh_barry_rival_lost: I told you I've been training! Now I'm gonna beat the Champion too!
sinnoh_old_charm_deliver: You delivered the Old Charm to the elder at Celestic Town.
The elder smiled warmly. 'Thank you, dear. This belonged to my family.'
As thanks, she shared the ancient knowledge of Surf with your Pokémon.
You received the ability to use SURF!
sinnoh_regigigas_awakening: The statue in the Snowpoint Temple begins to tremble...
Ancient power fills the room as Regigigas stirs from its thousand-year slumber!
sinnoh_dialga_encounter: Time itself seems to slow as a roar shakes Spear Pillar!
The ruler of time — Dialga — has descended!
sinnoh_palkia_encounter: Reality bends and warps across Spear Pillar!
The ruler of space — Palkia — has descended!
sinnoh_giratina_encounter: Deep within Turnback Cave, a rift tears open in the fabric of reality...
The ruler of the Distortion World — Giratina — emerges!
sinnoh_newgame_intro: Snow drifts softly over the rooftops of Twinleaf Town.
Your neighbor {rival_name} bursts through your front door.
{rival_name}: {player_name}! Did you hear? There's a red Gyarados at the lake! Come on!
sinnoh_mom_newstart_1: Mom: Off to Lake Verity with {rival_name} again? Bundle up, it's chilly!
Mom: Take good care of your Pokémon, and they'll take good care of you.
sinnoh_mom_newstart_2: Mom: I watched the Pokémon League on TV this morning. Cynthia is amazing!
Mom: Maybe someday I'll be watching YOU on that screen.
sinnoh_mom_newstart_3: Mom: Every time you win a battle, put a little prize money aside.
Mom: Who knows? Maybe one day it'll buy us a house in a whole new region!
sinnoh_mom_home_1: Mom: {player_name}! Welcome to our snowy little Twinleaf cottage!
Mom: Your Hoenn prize money covered it with plenty left for a fireplace.
Mom: I'm starting to collect houses the way you collect badges!
sinnoh_mom_home_2: Mom: Littleroot, Pallet, New Bark... and now Twinleaf.
Mom: The mail carrier needs a map just to keep track of my addresses!
sinnoh_mom_home_3: Mom: I joined a knitting club. We're making scarves for Snover!
Mom: Don't stay out too late near Lake Verity. The legends say a spirit lives there.
sinnoh_barry_house: {rival_name}'s Mom: Oh, {player_name}! {rival_name} ran off again in a hurry.
{rival_name}'s Mom: That child never walks anywhere. I hope he remembered his shoes!
hisui_laventon: Laventon: Welcome to Hisui, the land that will one day be called Sinnoh!
The Pokemon here look different from the ones you know. Hisuian forms, we call them.
They only live here... for now. Catch every one of them and who knows where they'll turn up!
Be careful of the Noble Pokemon. Calm them and they'll trust you.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: A Fateful Encounter
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Follow {rival_name} to Lake Verity: west along Route 201, past the Lakefront. Professor Rowan is there.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Home to Twinleaf
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: You drove off the Starly! Head home to Twinleaf Town. {rival_name} is itching for a first battle.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Professor's Lab
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Take Route 201 east to Sandgem Town and visit Professor Rowan in his lab.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: North to Jubilife
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: The Professor's assistant, next door in Sandgem, has Poké Balls for you. Then follow Route 202 north to Jubilife City.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: East to Oreburgh
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Pick up a Pokétch in Jubilife, then go east on Route 203 and through Oreburgh Gate. {rival_name} is waiting on the way.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Find Roark
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Oreburgh's Gym Leader is down in the Oreburgh Mine, south of the city. Go and find him.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Coal Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Roark is back at the Oreburgh City Gym. Rock types: Water and Grass moves hit hard.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Trouble in Jubilife
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Team Galactic is bothering Professor Rowan back in Jubilife City. Go and help!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: North to Floaroma
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Head north from Jubilife on Route 204, through the Ravaged Path, to Floaroma Town.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Valley Windworks
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Team Galactic has taken the Valley Windworks, east of Floaroma. Chase the grunts out of Floaroma Meadow for the Works Key first.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Through Eterna Forest
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Go north on Route 205 and through Eterna Forest to Eterna City.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Forest Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Challenge Gardenia at the Eterna City Gym. Grass types: Fire and Flying moves hit hard.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Galactic Eterna Building
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Meet Cynthia in Eterna for Cut, then storm Team Galactic's building at the north end of the city.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Cycling Road
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Collect your Bicycle at the Bike Shop, ride Cycling Road (Route 206) south, then east through Mt. Coronet to Hearthome City.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: On to Veilstone
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: The Hearthome Gym Leader is away. Travel east: Route 209, Solaceon Town, Routes 210 and 215, to Veilstone City.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Cobble Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Challenge Maylene at the Veilstone City Gym. Fighting types: Flying and Psychic moves hit hard.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Galactic Warehouse
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: A Galactic Grunt in Veilstone is up to something. Talk to him, take the Storage Key and raid the Warehouse.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: South to Pastoria
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Head south from Veilstone on Route 214, past Lake Valor, then west on Route 213 to Pastoria City.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Fen Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Challenge Crasher Wake at the Pastoria City Gym. Water types: Grass and Electric moves hit hard.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Relic Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Fantina is back at the Hearthome City Gym. Ghost types: Ghost and Dark moves hit hard.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: West to Canalave
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Surf west from Jubilife along Route 218 to Canalave City.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Mine Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Challenge Byron at the Canalave City Gym. Steel types: Fire, Fighting and Ground moves hit hard. Riley on Iron Island can help you train.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Old Charm
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Cynthia has an Old Charm for her grandmother. Carry it north, through Solaceon and the fog of Route 210, to Celestic Town.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Canalave Library
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Professor Rowan wants to meet at the Canalave Library.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Explosion at Lake Valor
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: A blast shook Lake Valor! Fly to Pastoria or Veilstone and hurry to the lake. Saturn is there.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Mars at Lake Verity
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Team Galactic is at Lake Verity too, near Twinleaf. Stop Commander Mars.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: North to Snowpoint
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Lake Acuity is in the far north. Cross Mt. Coronet from Route 211 to Route 216, then push through the snow of Route 217 to Snowpoint City.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Icicle Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Challenge Candice at the Snowpoint City Gym. Ice types: Fire, Fighting and Rock moves hit hard.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Lake Acuity
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: With the Icicle Badge the way to Lake Acuity is open, west of Snowpoint. Jupiter is waiting.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Raid Team Galactic HQ
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Team Galactic took all three lake Pokémon to Veilstone. Find the Galactic Key in the Warehouse Underpass and break into their HQ.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Spear Pillar
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Cyrus is climbing Mt. Coronet. Use Rock Climb to reach the Spear Pillar at the summit, beat Mars and Jupiter, then face him.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: East to Sunyshore
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Peace at last. Take Route 222 east from Lake Valor to Sunyshore City.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Beacon Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Challenge Volkner at the Sunyshore City Gym. Electric types: Ground moves hit hard.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Victory Road
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Surf north from Sunyshore on Route 223, climb the waterfall and cross Victory Road to the Pokémon League.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Sinnoh League
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: {rival_name} wants one last battle. Then the Elite Four, and Champion Cynthia.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Catch 30 Pokémon
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Own 30 different Pokémon from the Sinnoh Pokédex to earn a $5,000 bonus.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Catch 60 Pokémon
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Own 60 different Pokémon from the Sinnoh Pokédex to earn a $5,000 bonus.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Catch 90 Pokémon
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Own 90 different Pokémon from the Sinnoh Pokédex to earn a $5,000 bonus.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Complete the Sinnoh Pokédex
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Own all 108 Pokémon in the Sinnoh Pokédex to earn a $5,000 bonus. Professor Rowan will be proud.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Poké Balls from the Assistant
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: The Professor's assistant lives next to the lab in Sandgem Town and has Poké Balls to spare.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Pokétch
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: The Pokétch Company in Jubilife City is giving away its new watch.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Man in the Trench Coat
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: A strange man is hiding behind a lamp post in Jubilife City.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Cynthia's Gift
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Cynthia is in Eterna City, by the statue. She has something for a new Forest Badge holder.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Riley's Request
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Riley is training on Iron Island, by boat from Canalave City. Team up with him against Team Galactic.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Haunted Chateau
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Something flickers in the Old Chateau, deep in Eterna Forest.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Lake Guardians
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Mesprit, Azelf and Uxie have gone home to their caverns at Lakes Verity, Valor and Acuity.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Ruler of Time
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Dialga still waits at the Spear Pillar.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Ruler of Space
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Beyond the Spear Pillar, a rift in space has opened. Palkia is inside.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Distortion World Rift
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: At the Spear Pillar a rift opened, and Giratina dragged Cyrus into the Distortion World. Follow them!
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.reward: Cyrus, Giratina and the Griseous Orb

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Regigigas Awakening
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: As Champion you may enter Snowpoint Temple. Something huge sleeps at the bottom.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Battle Zone
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: A boat from Snowpoint City sails to the Fight Area. Stark Mountain rises beyond it.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Moonlit Islands
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Boats from Canalave now reach Fullmoon Island. Cresselia is said to rest there.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Master Poffin Chef
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Cook a Mild Poffin (level 50+) at the Poffin House in Hearthome City. Strong rare berries and perfect stirs are the secret.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Hisui Region
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Now that you have the Coal Badge, a space-time rift in Jubilife City leads to ancient Hisui. Catch every Hisuian form and they'll start appearing all over the world.
